fields.description: 360 Riverside Crescent is a residential tower in Sobha Hartland 2. Its one- and two-bedroom apartments include study-equipped variants. The drawings distinguish enclosed suites from outdoor balconies, with different proportions within each bedroom category.

sources.label: 360 Riverside Crescent own official brochure and plans

reviewCoverage.identity: 360 own brochure checked; adjacent Riverside towers excluded.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own drawings show one-, study-equipped one-, and two-bedroom layouts.
reviewCoverage.areas: PDF pages 50, 65 and 92 visually checked, with suite/balcony arithmetic.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Current own official FAQ facilities checked.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Current official 3.46m reference distinguished from portal launch 1.5m.
reviewCoverage.payment: Portal 20/60/20 adds to 100; alternative broker 20/40/40 unresolved.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own 117-page official PDF retrieved; numerical plans visually inspected.

overview: The 1.5-bedroom drawing contains one bedroom and a study/store. Saleable totals include balconies; additional outdoor space should not be read as a larger enclosed living area.
research.locationNote: Officially in Sobha Hartland 2, Dubai. Views vary by numbered unit and orientation.
research.priceNote: The developer displays AED 3.46m subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an AED 1.5m launch reference and marks the project sold out. Neither confirms a live unit or agreed resale price.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 60% construction and 20% handover. EZRE advertises 20/40/40 instead. No dated primary calendar was located; this conflict is unresolved and stages have not been blended.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives December 2027, shown as Q4 2027. A contractual completion schedule was not found in the retrieved brochure.
